title: Chapter 100 I Want To Challenge You
content:
Chapter 100 I Want To Challenge You

Seeing the five-clawed dragon hovering over the deserted city, blocking out the sun, everyone stopped what they were doing and looked at the sky in shock.

Their eyes were full of doubts.

Did the dragon mutate?

Because Ao Qing had always been with Lu Xue, most people in the deserted city did not recognize Ao Qing.

But some people recognized Ao Qing.

A figure suddenly appeared in the void and bowed respectfully to Ao Qing.

"Lord Ao Qing, I am sorry for not welcoming you from afar. Please forgive me."

Seeing that figure, countless desert guards were immediately shocked.

The red token on his waist was even more dazzling.

There were actually desert guards with red tokens in the deserted city, and they didn't even know about it.

I think it should be the leader who stayed to watch this place.

In the void, Ao Qing heard the voice, his eyes moved down, and he immediately saw the desert guard.

At this moment, the heart of the guard was pounding, and his whole body was trembling slightly.

There was no way, Ao Qing's oppression was too heavy.

The aura of the Lord of Gods was countless times stronger than that of their leader A Wei.

More importantly, Ao Qing's body became huge. He stood in front of Ao Qing, and his eyes were not even as big as Ao Qing's dragon pupils.

"Are you in charge here now?"

Ao Qing said in a light voice.

Hearing this, the guard nodded.

"It's me, sir, what do you want?"

Ao Qing looked at the distant sky and said, "Make room for a small world for me and wait for me to come back."

"Yes, I'll do it right away."

Then, Ao Qing twisted his huge dragon body and headed out of the deserted city.

On the spot, the red-level guard watched Ao Qing leave until Ao Qing's figure disappeared, then he breathed a sigh of relief and turned to leave.

......

Inside the Dragon Clan of the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

At this time, the atmosphere in the dragon clan was a little depressing.

Although most of the dragons have been upgraded in blood, their strength has become much stronger.

But at this time, they have already guessed something.

The head of the dragon clan, the ancestor of the dragon clan, has an extremely gloomy face at this moment.

All dragons have been upgraded in blood, except for himself. After a little thought, he can know who the source of the blood upgrade is.

Ao Qing!

In the corner, Ao Lie looked indifferent and calm.

Oh, if I had known this, why did I do it in the first place.

The powerful people in the clan had predicted that my son would lead the dragon clan to glory.

You, you actually drove my son out of the dragon clan.

"Humph."

At this time, Ao Lie couldn't help but snorted.

In an instant, all the dragon clan members looked at Ao Lie.

"Ao Lie, what do you want to do?"

The ancestor of the dragon clan looked at Ao Lie with a bad face.

At this moment, he was on the verge of anger.

Hearing the words of the ancestor, Ao Lie said calmly: "Ancestor, I don't want to do anything, and it will be the same in the future."

Hearing this, the dragons suddenly felt uneasy.

But the ancestor was full of breath.

"Ao Lie, do you really think I dare not touch you?!"

"Heh."

Ao Lie stood there, indifferent.

He didn't even look at the dragon ancestor from beginning to end.

Seeing this, the dragon ancestor couldn't bear it anymore.

"Ao Lie, you are so presumptuous!!"

Boom!

In an instant, the dragon ancestor made a direct move, and a dragon claw reached out to Ao Lie.

Instantly, the explosion sounded directly from the dragon clan.

However, after the smoke dissipated, the dragon ancestor's expression became even gloomier.

"You, want to rebel?"

See, six dragons joined forces to block his attack, and Ao Lie was safe and sound.

The leading dragon was the great elder of the dragon clan.

The great elder of the dragon clan said in a deep voice: "Ancestor, please be rational. You should know who is the source of the bloodline promotion."

"It is Ao Qing. Ao Qing has made great contributions to the entire dragon clan. You can't touch Ao Lie."

On the side, the other elders also echoed: "Ancestor, Ao Lie can't be touched."

"Ancestor, I suggest you restore Ao Qing's dragon identity as soon as possible."

Hearing these words, the dragon clan ancestor suddenly looked extremely gloomy.

His eyes swept across all the dragons present, and he was surprised to find that all the dragons looked at him with a bit of hostility.

He was now deserted by everyone.

"You,,"

And at this moment, a pressure suddenly rolled in from the distant sky.

What is that?

All of a sudden, all the dragon clan members looked in that direction.

I saw a five-clawed golden dragon emitting divine light all over its body flying towards here at a very fast speed.

Everywhere it passed, the void was broken layer by layer.

And this is just the strength of his physical body.

"Hahaha, my son Ao Qing is back!"

Looking at the giant dragon, Ao Lie suddenly shouted excitedly.

No matter what changes Ao Qing had, he could still recognize Ao Qing at a glance. After all, this was his own son.

"Lord Longzi, Lord Longzi is back!"

"Quick, go and welcome Lord Longzi!"

For a moment, all the giant dragons went outside, leaving only the ancestor of the dragon clan standing there with an ugly face.

Boom!

With a roar.

Ao Qing's huge dragon body suddenly descended into the dragon clan.

Seeing the changes of Ao Qing at this moment, countless dragon clan members were stunned.

Five claws, brown dragon pupils, terrifying blood pressure.

It took a long time before the cheers rang out of the field.

"We wait, welcome Lord Longzi!"

As early as the deserted city was in its prime, they regretted driving Ao Qing out of the Dragon Clan.

Fortunately, there is no need to blame them for this matter. Anyway, there is one who takes the blame.

Looking at the respect and admiration in the eyes of the dragons, Ao Qing didn't feel any turbulent in his heart.

He is now past that vain age.

"I'm back this time to lead the Dragon Clan and settle in the deserted city."

Hearing this, the dragons were stunned and suddenly became excited.

Nowadays, in the entire world of all spirits, who doesn’t know how good the treatment of that deserted city is.

Even the powerful Immortal Imperial Clan gave up his face and wanted to join the Huangcheng, and he didn't even want Huangcheng.

But now, they can directly settle in the deserted city, which makes them not excited.

However, at this moment, an angry shout suddenly rang out.

"Ao Qing, don't even think about it!"

The next moment, the figure of the Dragon Clan ancestor appeared in place.

At this time, Ao Qing and the Dragon Clan ancestor were both in their own state, but it’s a pity that the present is different from the past.

The ancestor of the dragon clan was like a reptile in front of Ao Qing.

After all, the strength varies greatly, Ao Qing has already entered the ranks of the dragon.

Seeing the dragon clan ancestor, Ao Qing's face turned cold.

"Aocheng, you are not qualified to command the dragon clan!"

Ao Qing said coldly.

At some point, all the Dragon Clan members had already stood behind Ao Qing.

Seeing this scene, the Dragon Clan ancestor's face looked even more ugly.

Behind Ao Qing, several elders kept shaking their heads.

As the oldest dragon in the dragon clan who is still alive, Aocheng is respected as the ancestor and should have been respected by the dragons.

But Aocheng made such a big mistake back then.

Even so, wouldn’t it be better to retreat to the back and retreat peacefully.

As a result, Ao Lie's position as the leader of the clan was abolished and he personally managed the entire dragon clan.

Now, everyone is betrayal.

Ao Cheng's majesty in the dragon clan has long since completely dissipated.

"Aocheng, I want to challenge you!"

At this time, Ao Qing continued to speak.
